Row.Text: Victories
Military Victory

To win a Military Victory, you must have significantly more Dominion than all other players. This amount starts high at the beginning of the Exploration Age, but decreases as the game progresses (See below for details). Once you have met or exceeded the required number of points, you start a countdown. If you maintain your lead for 5 turns, you win!

Sources of Dominion are as follows. Points are cumulative:[BLIST][LI] Settlements you control: 4 points[LI] Settlements you control which are an Original Capital: 4 points[LI] Settlements you control in Distant Lands: 1 point[LI] Settlements you captured: 1 point[LI] Settlements you captured from a leader with an opposed Ideology: 2 points[/BLIST]

To trigger the Victory Countdown, you need to be some amount higher than the second place leader. The amount is determined by how far through the game you are.[BLIST][LI] Antiquity Age: No victory available[LI] Transcendent Victory: 6x more points from Exploration Age 50% to 79% age progress [LI] Crushing Victory: 4x more points from Exploration Age 80% to Modern Age 20% age progress[LI] Decisive Victory: 3x more points from Modern Age 20% to 39% age progress[LI] Momentous Victory: 2x more points from Modern Age 40% to 59% age progress[LI] Substantive Victory: 1.5x more points from Modern Age 60% to 79% age progress[LI] Narrow Victory: 1.25x more points from Modern Age 80% to 100% age progress[/BLIST]

Once a player is in a Victory Countdown, they must hold on to their lead for 5 turns to win. If they are interrupted, their countdown progress is saved, and can be continued later if they meet the proper conditions again.

If the Modern Age ends without a winner, victory scoring consists of the following:[BLIST][LI] Total turns in a Victory Countdown: 1000 points per turn[LI] Your placing in each Victory category: 1000 points minus 10 times your ranking in each Victory[LI] Major Triumphs completed: 1 point each[/BLIST]
Cultural Victory

To win a Cultural Victory, you must have significantly more Tourism than all other players. This amount starts high at the beginning of the Exploration Age, but decreases as the game progresses (See below for details). Once you have met or exceeded the required number of points, you start a countdown. If you maintain your lead for 5 turns, you win!

Sources of Tourism are as follows:[BLIST][LI] Antiquity Age Wonders: 4 points (1 if conquered)[LI] Exploration Age Wonders: 8 points (2 if conquered)[LI] Modern Age Wonders: 12 points (3 if conquered)[LI] Exploration Age Slotted Relics: 3 points (Total is based on highest slotted count for the Age)[LI] Modern Age Slotted Artifacts: 5 points (Total is based on highest slotted count for the Age)[LI] Natural Wonder in your territory: 10 points per unique Natural Wonder[LI] Celebrations: 2 points per Age after Researching Entertainment[LI] Unique Improvements: 1 point for every type of Unique Improvement in a Settlement (4 points in Settlements connected by Rail after Researching Industrialization's Mastery in the Modern Age)[LI] Antiquity Age Unique Quarter Buildings: 1 points[LI] Exploration Age Unique Quarter Buildings: 2 points[LI] Modern Age Unique Quarter Buildings: 4 points, 7 points in Settlements with an Aerodrome after Researching Flight's Mastery [LI] Modern Age Resort Towns with at least 7 improved Breathtaking tiles: 4 points per tile after Researching Globalism's Mastery.[/BLIST]

To trigger the Victory Countdown, you need to be some amount higher than the second place leader. The amount is determined by how far through the game you are.[BLIST][LI] Antiquity Age: No victory available[LI] Transcendent Victory: 6x more points from Exploration Age 50% to 79% age progress [LI] Crushing Victory: 4x more points from Exploration Age 80% to Modern Age 20% age progress[LI] Decisive Victory: 3x more points from Modern Age 20% to 39% age progress[LI] Momentous Victory: 2x more points from Modern Age 40% to 59% age progress[LI] Substantive Victory: 1.5x more points from Modern Age 60% to 79% age progress[LI] Narrow Victory: 1.25x more points from Modern Age 80% to 100% age progress[/BLIST]

Economic Victory

To win an Economic Victory, you must have significantly more GDP than all other players. This amount starts high at the beginning of the Exploration Age, but decreases as the game progresses (See below for details). Once you have met or exceeded the required number of points, you start a countdown. If you maintain your lead for 5 turns, you win!

The following contribute to your GDP each turn:[BLIST][LI] Slotted City and Bonus Resources in Cities (Not Towns): 1 per turn after Researching The Wheel.[LI]Imported Resources Slotted in Cities (Not Towns): 1 per turn after researching Skilled trades.[LI]Returned Treasure Convoys: 20 points per Cargo (Scaled by game speed).[LI] Slotted Factory Resources in Settlements (Cities and Towns): 2 per turn after Researching Mass Production.[LI] Gold Buildings from the current Age: 2 per turn after Researching Currency.[/BLIST]

To trigger the Victory Countdown, you need to be some amount higher than the second place leader. The amount is determined by how far through the game you are.[BLIST][LI] Antiquity Age: No victory available[LI] Transcendent Victory: 6x more points from Exploration Age 50% to 79% age progress [LI] Crushing Victory: 4x more points from Exploration Age 80% to Modern Age 20% age progress[LI] Decisive Victory: 3x more points from Modern Age 20% to 39% age progress[LI] Momentous Victory: 2x more points from Modern Age 40% to 59% age progress[LI] Substantive Victory: 1.5x more points from Modern Age 60% to 79% age progress[LI] Narrow Victory: 1.25x more points from Modern Age 80% to 100% age progress[/BLIST]

Scientific Victory
To win a Scientific Victory, you must win the Space Race by earning 100 Innovation, and then having an active Launch Pad (In the Modern Age) for 5 turns, after which you win!

Sources of Innovation are as follows:[BLIST][LI] Antiquity Age Slotted Codices: 1 point (Total is based on highest slotted count for the Age)[LI] Antiquity Age Project Chart the Stars: 5 points[LI] Antiquity Age Project Spherical Earth: 5 points[LI] Exploration Age Project Heliocentric Model: 5 points[LI] Exploration Age Project Discover Calculus: 10 points[LI] Modern Age Project Break the Sound Barrier: 5 points[LI] Modern Age Project Trans-Oceanic Flight: 5 points[LI] Modern Age Project Launch Satellite: 5 points[LI] Modern Age Project Radio Telescope: 5 points[LI] Modern Age Project Crewed Space Flight Preparation: 15 points (repeatable)[LI] Various Technology Masteries: 2 to 5 points [LI] Various Wonders: 3 points[/BLIST]

In contrast to the Military, Cultural, and Economic Victories, to trigger the Victory Countdown for Science you need to reach 100 Innovation and have an active Launchpad (Buildable in the Modern Age). Any number of players can be in this countdown at the same time. If you haven't managed to achieve 100 Innovation even after completing the Crewed Space Flight Preperation project, note that you can run it any number of times to get to the goal.

Once a player is in a Victory Countdown for Science, they must maintain an active Launchpad. If at any point all of their Launchpads are pillaged or captured, their countdown progress is paused and saved, and can be continued later if they have an active Launchpad again.

If the Modern Age ends without a winner, victory scoring consists of the following:[BLIST][LI] Total turns in a Victory Countdown: 1000 points per turn[LI] Your placing in each Victory category: 1000 points minus 10 times your ranking in each Victory[LI] Major Triumphs completed: 1 point each[/BLIST]
Score Victory
If no player achieves a Military, Cultural, Economic, or Scientific Victory before the Modern Age ends, the game is decided by Score Victory.

Your score consists of the following:[BLIST][LI] Total turns in a Victory Countdown: 1000 points per turn[LI] Your placing in each Victory category: 1000 points minus 10 times your ranking in each Victory[LI] Major Triumphs completed: 1 point each[/BLIST]
